what: A single card (3×2 pieces, 773:512 aspect) on a screen-fixed WebGL layer follows placeholders around the document in scroll order — from the end of one section to the start of the next, the placeholder position · width and the pose (tilt · turn · spin · spread · gone · shadow) blend with smoothstep, and along the path (via) it tilts an extra sin(πt). At spread 1 the pieces separate by .5~.85 of the card width and spin on their own, and at gone 1 the even-numbered pieces fly out to 4.5~5.5 times the card width and vanish. A pinned section stays for data-hold (screen height %) length, and span divides that so several sections share one spot. On desktop, when first opened, the pieces are released in sequence over 0~.7s from 2.2× the card width outside and gather with a critically damped spring (stiffness 30), and the card tilts toward the mouse by up to .2 · .15 rad (τ ≈ .29s). In hover-glow sections the cell under the cursor glows at 1 and its neighbors at .3 (rise 18/s · fall 2.4/s), and in sparkle sections 5 cells per second twinkle for .9s

options.cell-cols: Number of grid columns in the right cell, default 6
options.fly: If off, turns off the initial gathering motion
options.wait: When on, gathers when the element receives an fx:play event (after the loader)
options.narrow: Below this width (px) counts as a phone — turns off tilt, gathering and cell glow and uses data-hold-narrow, default 1024
options.[data-fx-part=slot]: Placeholder — data-pose="spread: 1; spin: tau"(Pose, tau = 2π), data-via (tilt·turn·spin to add along the way), data-leave (spread on leaving), data-span=".42,.58"(Share within the section’s fixed length), data-follow="Selector"(that element’s place instead of this element), data-chapter="Selector"(section element, default is the nearest [data-hold]·article·section·header), data-sparkle, data-hover-glow, data-ride (not mixed with the preceding slot, skipped if more than half)

note: Load three first: load this folder’s three-global.js before three.cjs and it can be read as window.THREE. Shaders are precompiled when attached. The original’s model (glb), ambient light, bloom post-processing, the screensaver that spins after 12s idle and the Try it yourself slot game were not carried over. Pieces are our box shapes, and the glow is an emissive cell drawing
